CREATE VIEW [Finance].[vw_CUS__GeneralLedgerTranslatedData] WITH SCHEMABINDING AS
SELECT [AlternateChartKey] = [GldAttribute].[AlternateChartKey], [Attribute_LFE] = [GldAttribute].[Attribute_LFE], [Attribute_LFO] = [GldAttribute].[Attribute_LFO], [Attribute_OCG] = [GldAttribute].[Attribute_OCG], [Attribute_ORG] = [GldAttribute].[Attribute_ORG], [Attribute_SPR] = [GldAttribute].[Attribute_SPR], [Attribute_TIC] = [GldAttribute].[Attribute_TIC], [BranchKey] = [GldAttribute].[BranchKey], [CompanyKey] = [GldAttribute].[CompanyKey], [CompanyOfPeriodKey] = [GldAttribute].[CompanyOfPeriodKey], [DepartmentKey] = [GldAttribute].[DepartmentKey], [GeneralLedgerDataAttributeKey] = [GldAttribute].[GeneralLedgerDataAttributeKey], [GeneralLedgerDataKey] = [GldAttribute].[GeneralLedgerDataKey], [GLAccountKey] = [GldAttribute].[GLAccountKey], [LocalAmount] = [GldAttribute].[LocalAmount], [LocalCurrency] = [GldAttribute].[LocalCurrency], [OrganizationKey] = [GldAttribute].[OrganizationKey], [OriginalAttribute_LFE] = [GldAttribute].[OriginalAttribute_LFE], [OriginalAttribute_LFO] = [GldAttribute].[OriginalAttribute_LFO], [OriginalAttribute_OCG] = [GldAttribute].[OriginalAttribute_OCG], [OriginalAttribute_ORG] = [GldAttribute].[OriginalAttribute_ORG], [OriginalAttribute_SPR] = [GldAttribute].[OriginalAttribute_SPR], [OriginalAttribute_TIC] = [GldAttribute].[OriginalAttribute_TIC], [PeriodManagementKey] = [GldAttribute].[PeriodManagementKey], [PostDate] = [GldAttribute].[PostDate], [PostPeriodForReportingBook] = [GldAttribute].[PostPeriodForReportingBook], [ReportingBookCode] = [GldAttribute].[ReportingBookCode], [ReportingBookKey] = [GldAttribute].[ReportingBookKey], [TransactionCategory] = [GldAttribute].[TransactionCategory], [TranslatedCurrency] = [GldAttribute].[TranslatedCurrency], [AlternateGLAccount] = [Account].DestinationAccountNo, [AlternateGLAccountDescription] = [Account].[Description], [AlternateGLAccountKey] = [Account].AlternateGLAccountKey, [AccountTypeCode] = [Account].AccountTypeCode, [Units] = [Account].[StatisticalUnits], [OriginalAccount] = [Account].[OriginalAccount], [ExchangeRatesForReportingBookKey] = IIF([GldAttribute].TranslatedCurrency = [GldAttribute].LocalCurrency, -1, [ExchangeRate].[ExchangeRatesForReportingBookKey]), [CurrencyTranslationForReportingBookKey] = IIF([GldAttribute].TranslatedCurrency = [GldAttribute].LocalCurrency, -1, ISNULL(AccountCurrencyTranslation.CurrencyTranslationForReportingBookKey, [CurrencyTranslation].CurrencyTranslationForReportingBookKey)), [CurrencyTranslationLevel] = ISNULL(AccountCurrencyTranslation.CurrencyTranslationLevel, [CurrencyTranslation].CurrencyTranslationLevel), [TranslatedRateType] = ISNULL(AccountCurrencyTranslation.ExRateType, [CurrencyTranslation].ExRateType), [IsReciprocal] = CurrencyTranslation.IsReciprocal, [TranslatedExchangeRate] = CASE WHEN [GldAttribute].TranslatedCurrency = [GldAttribute].LocalCurrency THEN 1 ELSE [ExchangeRate].SellRate END, [TranslatedAmount] = CASE WHEN [GldAttribute].TranslatedCurrency = [GldAttribute].LocalCurrency THEN [GldAttribute].LocalAmount WHEN CurrencyTranslation.IsReciprocal = 1 THEN ROUND([GldAttribute].LocalAmount/[ExchangeRate].SellRate, LEN(CurrencyTranslation.SubUnitRatio) - 1) WHEN CurrencyTranslation.IsReciprocal = 0 THEN ROUND([GldAttribute].LocalAmount * [ExchangeRate].SellRate, LEN(CurrencyTranslation.SubUnitRatio) - 1) ELSE NULL END, [SubUnitRatio] = CurrencyTranslation.SubUnitRatio FROM Finance.CUS__GeneralLedgerDataAttribute [GldAttribute] LEFT JOIN [Finance].[CUS__AlternateGLAccountData] AS [Account] ON [Account].AlternateChartKey = GldAttribute.AlternateChartKey AND [Account].GLAccountKey = GldAttribute.GlAccountKey AND ([Account].CompanyKey = GldAttribute.CompanyKey OR [Account].CompanyKey IS NULL) AND Account.Attribute_LFE = [GldAttribute].Attribute_LFE AND Account.Attribute_LFO = [GldAttribute].Attribute_LFO AND Account.Attribute_TIC = [GldAttribute].Attribute_TIC AND Account.Attribute_OCG = [GldAttribute].Attribute_OCG AND Account.Attribute_ORG = [GldAttribute].Attribute_ORG AND Account.Attribute_SPR = [GldAttribute].Attribute_SPR LEFT JOIN Finance.CUS__CurrencyTranslationForReportingBook CurrencyTranslation ON CurrencyTranslation.CompanyKey = GldAttribute.CompanyKey AND CurrencyTranslation.AccReportingBookKey = GldAttribute.ReportingBookKey AND CurrencyTranslation.AccountType = [Account].AccountTypeCode LEFT JOIN Finance.CUS__CurrencyTranslationForReportingBook AccountCurrencyTranslation on AccountCurrencyTranslation.CompanyKey = GldAttribute.CompanyKey AND AccountCurrencyTranslation.AccReportingBookKey = GldAttribute.ReportingBookKey AND AccountCurrencyTranslation.AlternateGLAccountKey = [Account].AlternateGLAccountKey LEFT JOIN Finance.CUS__ExchangeRatesforReportingbook [ExchangeRate] ON ExchangeRate.CompanyKey = GldAttribute.CompanyKey AND GldAttribute.PostDate BETWEEN ExchangeRate.StartDate AND ExchangeRate.EndDate AND ExchangeRate.ExRateType = ISNULL(AccountCurrencyTranslation.ExRateType, CurrencyTranslation.ExRateType) AND ExchangeRate.Currency = CurrencyTranslation.Currency AND ISNULL(AccountCurrencyTranslation.CurrencyTranslationLevel, CurrencyTranslation.CurrencyTranslationLevel) = 'JNL'
